pin_label: Redwoods, California (coast redwoods / giant sequoia groves)

current_plate_do_not_resuggest.title: Californian redwood trees (Sequoia sempervirens), group of trees in the Mariposa Grove
current_plate_do_not_resuggest.author: Colour lithograph by W. H. McFarlane (Wellcome Collection)

candidates.title: Giant Redwood Trees of California
candidates.artist_collection: Albert Bierstadt; The Berkshire Museum (Google Art Project)
candidates.printed_border_or_mount: None; oil painting, no printed border to trim.
candidates.fit_note: Unambiguous coast-redwood forest interior: towering red trunks, filtered light, waterfall and Native figures for scale. The strongest, most iconic redwood-grove vista here.

candidates.title: The mammoth trees (Sequoia gigantea), California (Calaveras County)
candidates.artist_collection: Chromolithograph 'executed in oil colors' by Middleton, Strobridge & Co., Cincinnati; after A. J. Campbell (Library of Congress)
candidates.printed_border_or_mount: Yes; the sky arches to rounded top corners (arched vignette). Top and side edges would need trimming/cropping to lose the rounded mount.
candidates.fit_note: Genuine 19th-C colour chromolithograph of the Calaveras Big Trees grove: giant sequoias, felled 'Big Tree' log, stump and the grove hotel. Best true-print option and the only landscape-orientation candidate; slightly touristic (hotel/figures) rather than pristine wilderness.

candidates.title: The Grizzly Giant Sequoia, Mariposa Grove, California
candidates.artist_collection: Albert Bierstadt; Los Angeles County Museum of Art (LACMA 53.30)
candidates.printed_border_or_mount: None; oil study, no printed border to trim.
candidates.fit_note: Clearly a giant-sequoia grove: the gnarled Grizzly Giant trunk against tall conifers receding into the Mariposa Grove. Cooler, quieter palette; a strong second painting but lower native resolution than the other Bierstadts.

candidates.title: California Redwoods
candidates.artist_collection: Albert Bierstadt; Saint Louis Art Museum (735:1991)
candidates.fit_note: Sunset over a wooded Sierra valley with two tall trees in the foreground. Weakest fit: the trees read as generic tall conifers/pines rather than obvious redwoods, and it borders on the 'generic pine forest' the brief warns against. Included for completeness.
